notes.title: English version is available now!
notes.notes:
The translation is finally done.We are happy to announce the release of the English version today! 
It is supposed to be automatically downloaded if you are using steam in English.

If you have any problem or suggesstion about the English version, please report it in this thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/593200/discussions/0/1327844097131777725/

Please enjoy! 

In case the "automatically" part is not working:
In your game library, right click on this game entry and select "properties". Go to the language tab and switch the language here. This should be working.
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28002363/984067f648d2707f1d70a1f05bbe94bf4f555dda.png
